description: REQ-S1 says 'gig-cli.sh STARTUP prompt' is rewritten to 1 line invoking proactive-loop.sh. PROP-S1 tests file content length is ≤200 chars. But neither REQ-S1 nor the launchd-plist change in CoDD specifies what happens to the existing 8000-char prompt body that contained REQ-B1..B5 logic. Either (i) the logic moves into proactive-loop.sh (then proactive-loop.sh's invariants must subsume B1..B5 — but Group P REQs don't mention B1/B2/B3/B4/B5), or (ii) the logic is silently dropped (= regression). Spec must explicitly state the migration of the 8000-char prompt's semantic content into Group P/H/Q/B requirements.

evidence.snippet: REQ-S1 Gig slot migration: rewrite gig-cli.sh STARTUP prompt so the slot's cron prompt body becomes bash ~/anicca/skills/_shared/proactive-loop.sh gig (= 1 line) instead of the current 8000-character B1-B5 prompt.
